newsitem.title: USA: Alkermes cites positive Phase II data.
newsitem.headline: Alkermes cites positive Phase II data.

text.p: Alkermes Inc said on Monday it had positive results from two European Phase II clinical trials of the combination of its drug delivery agent RMP-7 and the chemotherapeutic agent carboplatin.
In the trials, the drugs were delivered intravenously to patients with recurrent, malignant brain tumors.
The results showed the drug combination was well tolerated and provided positive responses as measured by patients' neurological impairment, performance status and tumor volume, Alkermes said.
Carboplatin is a chemotherapeutic agent used in treating various tumor types outside of the brain, but is limited in its ability to penetrate into the brain.
RMP-7 is designed to enable more effective use of chemotherapeutic agents such as carboplatin in the treatment of brain tumors by briefly increasing the permeability of the blood-brain barrier.

"The successful completion of these two European clinical trials is an important milestone in our development program for RMP-7 as an agent to increase drug delivery to the brain," said Richard Pops, Alkermes chief executive.
